tools.name: emerging
tools.description: Small GitHub repositories (under 1,000 stars a week ago, at least 30 days old) gaining stars at least twice as fast as in a usual week, by that ratio; optionally in one topic. The same list as Upstar's Emerging page (or the topic's Emerging tab).

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: A collection's ranking (score = momentum and health with the collection's weights) and its rising newcomers under 90 days old: the same lists as the collection's page on Upstar.

tools.name: get_repo
tools.description: One GitHub repository as Upstar sees it, the same facts as its Upstar page: stars and gains, its usual week, its star total week by week over 12 weeks, its topics and ranks, when Upstar spotted it, its latest release, license, activity and collections. Answers for every repository with an Upstar pag

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Upstar's collections: open-source tools that do one job, or alternatives to one product, each ranked by momentum and health. Use a slug with get_collection.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: Lists the topics Upstar ranks GitHub repositories in (emulation, self-hosted, Rust, MCP…): slug, name, category, description and how many repositories rank in each this week. Use a slug with topic_ranking or emerging.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Upstar's search, the same as the site's search bar: topics by whole words (a name, slug, GitHub tag, language or keyword equal to the query, then every word of it in the topic's name, category or description) and every repository with an Upstar page (by name, description, GitHub topics and language;

tools.name: spotted_early
tools.description: Repositories whose stars at least doubled since Upstar first ranked them in a topic, at any rank: when, in which topic and at which rank it first ranked them, their stars then and now. Most grown first: the same list as Upstar's Spotted early page.

tools.name: topic_ranking
tools.description: Ranks a topic's GitHub repositories by star velocity (stars gained ÷ √stars before) over the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days, with the stars each gained: the same list as the topic's page on Upstar. Page with offset (next_offset).

tools.name: trending
tools.description: The fastest-rising GitHub repositories across every topic Upstar tracks, by star velocity or by stars gained, over 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days; new_only keeps repositories created in the last 7 days. The same list as Upstar's Trending page.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "spotted_early" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Repositories Upstar ranked before they took off: when and in which topic it first ranked them, their stars then and now. Most grown first: the same list as Upstar's Spotted early page." → after: "Repositories whose stars at least doubled since Upstar first ranked them in a topic, at any rank: when, in which topic and at which rank it first ranked them, their stars then and now. Most grown first: the same list as Upstar's Spotted early page."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
